sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "trader"."tradekind" AS g, AVG((CAST(("compliancecase"."risksc" - "compliancecase"."modelconf") AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."modelconf")) AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref" GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, ("s2"."m1" - "s3"."v") AS m2 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s2"."m1" > "s3"."v"), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m1") AS v FROM "s4"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m1" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m1" > "s5"."v") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
